claim: OTA was detected in 53 of 65 samples.
12 of 65 samples were below the 0.23 µg/kg LOD.
Detection prevalence differed significantly between years.
The overall OTA concentration distribution changed significantly across 2021–2024.
OTA contamination increased monotonically from 2021 to 2024.
Some detected-only analyses showed year-associated differences.
The detected-only sensitivity analysis became significant after removing the 19.11 µg/kg observation.
The 19.11 µg/kg observation alone establishes a temporal trend.
A temporal increase in OTA contamination has been demonstrated.
The dataset demonstrates OTA toxin production from sequence evidence.
basis: Published concentration data are not sequence-paired
